definition: a piece of timber fixed upright in the ground
description: A bearded man in a checked shirt works outdoors on a sunny lawn beside a wire fence. He raises a hammer over his head and drives it down onto the top of a short round wooden upright. He kneels and sets the upright into a freshly dug hole in the earth next to a taller square one, then stands and swings the hammer down on it again to drive it into the ground, and wipes his forehead on his sleeve.

taps.phrase: to hold up the wire fence

de.answer: Er schlägt einen Pfosten in den Boden.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está clavando un poste en el suelo.
